need.purpose_or_required_outcome: Research supplied material, summarize findings, and compose a final report using known sequential responsibilities.

reused_asset_or_evidence_refs: existing report composition capability where applicable

solution.mechanism_or_implementation_candidate: one workflow with replaceable research/summarize procedures
solution.short_rationale: Named roles do not by themselves justify independent adaptive agents; the responsibility path is known.

evidence_requirements: same responsibilities complete without independent agent loops
role separation can be replaced by Skills/procedures
no loss of required observable behavior

governance.stop_condition: Stop at the simplest composition that satisfies the known responsibilities.
